aisles.decision: Organic produce by default; check the USDA Organic seal or organic bin sign.
For frozen produce, choose organic bags listing only fruit or vegetables, with loose pieces.

picks.decision: Organic pears are the pick.
picks.avoid: Press the narrow neck by the stem, which should give slightly.
picks.title: Pears

picks.decision: Organic peaches and nectarines are the pick.
picks.avoid: Look for fuzzy peach skin in red or yellow.
picks.title: Peaches and nectarines

picks.decision: Organic plums are the pick.
picks.avoid: Leave the natural white or gray sheen on plum skin.
picks.title: Plums

picks.decision: Organic cherries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick shiny, dark cherries with green stems still attached.
picks.title: Cherries

picks.decision: Organic strawberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip berries with white or green shoulders around the caps.
picks.title: Strawberries

picks.decision: Organic blueberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Look for silver-white frost on blueberry skins; reject boxes containing leaves.
picks.title: Blueberries

picks.decision: Organic raspberries and blackberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Check the clamshell bottom for juice stains.
picks.title: Raspberries and blackberries

picks.decision: Organic snap and snow peas are the pick.
picks.avoid: Choose snap pods that look plump and snug around the peas.

picks.decision: Organic okra are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick pods two to four inches long, neither dull nor shriveled.

picks.decision: Organic sweet potatoes are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick small or medium sweet potatoes; even, deep-colored skin, no holes.
picks.title: Sweet potatoes

picks.decision: Organic carrots are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip carrots with large green areas at the top.
picks.title: Carrots

picks.decision: Organic beets are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick small beets with slender tap roots and leaf stems attached.
picks.title: Beets

picks.decision: Organic radishes are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick brightly colored radishes still topped with fresh green leaves.
picks.title: Radishes

picks.decision: Organic turnips are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip turnips with many leaf scars ringing the top.
picks.title: Turnips

picks.decision: Organic celery is the pick.
picks.avoid: Split celery; the inside should look pale to bright green, crisp.

picks.decision: Organic kohlrabi is the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip cracked or brown-spotted kohlrabi; attached leaves should be firm.

picks.decision: Organic spinach is the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick spinach with broad, crisp, dark green leaves.
picks.title: Spinach

picks.decision: Organic romaine and leaf lettuce are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip extremely solid, pale heads, which are mostly core.
picks.title: Romaine and leaf lettuce

picks.decision: Organic iceberg lettuce is the pick.
picks.avoid: Press the top of the head and avoid hard bumps.
picks.title: Iceberg lettuce

picks.decision: Organic broccoli is the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip heads whose flower ends part easily or show yellow blooms.
picks.title: Broccoli

picks.decision: Organic cauliflower is the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip heads with gaps between the curds.
picks.title: Cauliflower

picks.decision: Organic brussels sprouts are the pick.
picks.avoid: Look for bright green heads with white stem ends.
picks.title: Brussels sprouts

picks.decision: Organic cabbage is the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip heads that are oblong or cracked.
picks.title: Cabbage

picks.decision: Organic asparagus is the pick.
picks.avoid: Choose spears with tips firmly closed.

picks.decision: Organic leeks are the pick.
picks.avoid: Leek tops fresh green; necks at most one and a half inches.
picks.title: Leeks

picks.decision: Organic cantaloupe is the pick.
picks.avoid: Look for a smooth, rounded scar where the stem was.
picks.title: Cantaloupe

picks.decision: Organic honeydew is the pick.
picks.avoid: Choose pale yellow to light lemon skin with little green.
picks.title: Honeydew

picks.decision: Organic watermelon is the pick.
picks.avoid: Turn it over and look for a yellow, not white, underside.
picks.title: Watermelon

picks.decision: Organic mangoes are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip mangoes with sap on the skin.

picks.decision: Organic kiwi is the pick.
picks.avoid: Press lightly: ripe kiwi releases to gentle pressure.
picks.title: Kiwi

picks.decision: Organic oranges and grapefruit are the pick.
picks.avoid: Pick oranges and grapefruit heavy for their size, with smooth skin.
picks.title: Oranges and grapefruit

picks.decision: Organic lemons and limes are the pick.
picks.avoid: For limes, look for smooth, glossy dark green skin.
picks.title: Lemons and limes

picks.decision: Organic pomegranate is the pick.
picks.avoid: Look for a slightly square shape, not perfectly round.
picks.title: Pomegranate

picks.decision: Organic dry onions are the pick.
picks.avoid: Check the neck: small and dry, with no moisture.
picks.title: Dry onions

picks.decision: Organic garlic is the pick.
picks.avoid: Choose heavy bulbs that stay closed, with dry outer skins.
picks.title: Garlic

picks.decision: Organic winter squash and pumpkin are the pick.
picks.avoid: Check the stem: it should be dry and firm.

picks.decision: Organic frozen wild blueberries are the pick over fresh.
picks.avoid: Bag says “wild”; ingredients list blueberries alone.
picks.title: Frozen wild blueberries

picks.decision: Organic frozen cultivated blueberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: No “wild” on the bag means planted highbush; ingredients blueberries alone.
picks.title: Frozen cultivated blueberries

picks.decision: Organic frozen strawberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Berries loose, not one clump; ingredients strawberries alone.
picks.title: Frozen strawberries

picks.decision: Organic frozen raspberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Whole berries, loose in the bag; ingredients raspberries alone.
picks.title: Frozen raspberries

picks.decision: Organic frozen blackberries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Plump glossy berries loose in the bag; ingredients blackberries alone.
picks.title: Frozen blackberries

picks.decision: Organic frozen pitted cherries are the pick.
picks.avoid: Cherries loose, deep dark color; ingredients cherries alone, no sweeteners.
picks.title: Frozen pitted cherries

picks.decision: Organic frozen berry blends are the pick.
picks.avoid: Ingredients name berries like strawberry and blueberry; no sweeteners or juice.
picks.title: Frozen berry blends

picks.decision: Organic frozen mango chunks are the pick.
picks.avoid: Chunks loose, not fused; ingredients mango alone, no sweetener line.
picks.title: Frozen mango chunks

picks.decision: Organic frozen tropical fruit is the pick.
picks.avoid: Ingredients name mango, pineapple or papaya; no sweeteners, syrup or juice.
picks.title: Frozen tropical fruit

picks.decision: Organic frozen papaya chunks are the pick.
picks.avoid: Organic seal on the bag; ingredients papaya alone.
picks.title: Frozen papaya chunks

picks.decision: Organic frozen acai packs are the pick.
picks.avoid: Ingredients name acai alone; skip packs listing sweeteners before the fruit.
picks.title: Frozen acai packs

picks.decision: Organic frozen peas are the pick over fresh.
picks.avoid: Bright round peas, loose in the bag; ingredients peas alone.

picks.decision: Organic frozen corn kernels are the pick over fresh.
picks.avoid: Kernels loose, not one block; ingredients corn alone, organic seal.
picks.title: Frozen corn kernels

picks.decision: Organic frozen spinach is the pick.
picks.avoid: Ingredients spinach alone; skip creamed bags listing cream or starch.
picks.title: Frozen spinach

picks.decision: Organic frozen greens are the pick.
picks.avoid: Chopped leaves loose, not one solid block; ingredients name greens only.
picks.title: Frozen greens

picks.decision: Organic frozen broccoli florets are the pick.
picks.avoid: Dark green compact florets, no yellow buds; ingredients broccoli alone.

picks.decision: Organic frozen cauliflower florets are the pick.
picks.avoid: Creamy white florets, no gray or brown; ingredients cauliflower alone.
picks.title: Frozen cauliflower florets

picks.decision: Organic frozen riced vegetables are the pick.
picks.avoid: Riced cauliflower bag: ingredients say cauliflower alone, no starch or seasoning.
picks.title: Frozen riced vegetables

picks.decision: Organic fresh carrots are the pick over frozen carrots.
picks.avoid: Pieces separate, not a frozen clump; ingredients carrots alone, organic seal.
picks.title: Frozen carrots

picks.decision: Organic frozen green beans are the pick.
picks.avoid: Slim crisp-looking pods, ingredients green beans alone, no white frost.
picks.title: Frozen green beans

picks.decision: Organic frozen brussels sprouts are the pick.
picks.avoid: Small tight sprouts; ingredients Brussels sprouts alone, no loose leaves.
picks.title: Frozen Brussels sprouts

picks.decision: Organic frozen edamame is the pick over fresh.
picks.avoid: Beans or pods loose; ingredients edamame alone, organic seal on bag.
picks.title: Frozen edamame

picks.decision: Organic frozen stir-fry blends are the pick.
picks.avoid: Skip bags with a sauce packet; ingredients name vegetables only.
picks.title: Frozen stir-fry blends

picks.decision: Organic frozen mixed vegetables are the pick.
picks.avoid: Ingredients: peas, carrots, corn, green beans; bag loose, not a block.
picks.title: Frozen mixed vegetables

picks.decision: Organic frozen summer squash is the pick.
picks.avoid: Slices separate; ingredients squash or zucchini alone, organic seal.
picks.title: Frozen summer squash

picks.decision: Organic frozen winter squash cubes are the pick.
picks.avoid: Orange cubes loose; ingredients squash alone, no butter or sweeteners.
picks.title: Frozen winter squash cubes

picks.decision: Skip sauced frozen vegetables; choose plain organic frozen vegetables instead.
picks.avoid: Skip butter, cream, cheese, sauce or seasoning in frozen vegetable ingredients.
picks.title: Sauced frozen vegetables

picks.decision: Skip sweetened frozen fruit; choose plain organic frozen fruit instead.
picks.avoid: Skip sweeteners, syrup or juice concentrate; fruit should be the whole list.
picks.title: Sweetened frozen fruit

produce_grapes.why: Grapes are eaten whole with the skin on; organic growing rules restrict synthetic substances and exclude GMOs.
pick_steps: Lift the bunch and check for split, bruised or leaking grapes.

produce_peppers.why: The pepper wall and skin are eaten, and organic rules bar synthetic substances and GMOs in growing.
pick_steps: Pick a firm, unbruised pepper and pass on any that has shriveled or softened.

produce_tomatoes.why: The skin is eaten, and organic rules bar synthetic substances and GMOs in growing.
pick_steps: Press gently; pass on any tomato that is soft or bruised.

produce_green_beans.why: The whole pod is eaten, and organic rules bar synthetic substances and GMOs in growing.
pick_steps: Check the pods and leave any that are flabby, rust-spotted or sticky.

sprouts_raw.why: Sprouts are eaten whole and raw, and organic rules bar synthetic substances and GMOs in growing.
pick_steps: Check the roots are still white and the clamshell is not fogged.

produce_mushrooms.why: The whole cap is eaten, and organic rules bar synthetic substances and GMOs in growing.
pick_steps: Check each cap and leave any that feels damp or soft.

produce_bananas.why: The peel is discarded, but organic is still the default. Organic rules (7 CFR 205.105) bar synthetic substances, GMOs, irradiation and sewage sludge in growing.
pick_steps: Take a bunch that is still green and keep it out of the fridge.

produce_avocados.why: The skin is discarded, but organic is still the default. Organic rules (7 CFR 205.105) bar synthetic substances, GMOs, irradiation and sewage sludge in growing.
pick_steps: Press gently near the stem; firm but not rock hard ripens in days.

do_lines.produce_grapes: Grapes should hang firmly on green stems, not brown ones.
do_lines.produce_peppers: Pick firm, thick-walled, brightly colored peppers with a fresh green stem.
do_lines.produce_tomatoes: Skip tomatoes with blotchy green or brown patches on the skin.
do_lines.produce_green_beans: Run a finger along the pod and skip lumpy sections.
do_lines.sprouts_raw: Reject any tub holding dry or slimy sprouts.
do_lines.produce_mushrooms: Peek under the cap for pink or light tan gills.
do_lines.produce_bananas: Check for slight green at the stem and tip.
do_lines.produce_avocados: Skip avocados with large indentations in the skin.
